messages:
lina: Hey team — just got an escalated DPA erasure request from a EU customer (reported via support ticket). They ran our `/v1/data/erase` flow and got a 500 during the backend export step: `KMS access denied`. They need: (1) confirmation we can delete their data, (2) audit log slice showing delete/export events, and (3) proof of key custody (HSM/KMS) for EU residency. Can security/infra confirm the exact scope we can attest to and what evidence we can produce? :eyes:
support-bot: Ticket #T-48291 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P1 — customer awaiting compliance evidence.

raj: Thanks Lina. Can you paste the support ticket ID and the customer org ID here? Need to pull the exact export attempt trace. Also which KMS key ARN did the error reference (if any)?
lina: Ticket T-48291, org: org_aceu_004, error log showed `projects/redwood-prod/locations/eu-west1/keyRings/rdw-keys/cryptoKeys/tenant-eu-01` in the call stack. The customer emphasized they want evidence that data and keys never left EU.
marta: I pulled the backend trace for that timeframe (approx 2026-11-09T14:22Z). The flow failed during the export job step (export->s3 staging) when the runtime attempted envelope decrypt using the KMS key above. Cloud KMS returned PERMISSION_DENIED from our service account. I can extract the request_id and the audit log entries.

raj: Good. Two things from security side: (A) we can produce Cloud Audit Logs entries showing the KMS decrypt/verify attempts and the identity that called KMS (service account). (B) For HSM custody proof: for the managed KMS we can provide key metadata (location, purpose, protection level) — e.g., `protectionLevel: HSM` and the key ring region. We cannot publish raw key material (obv).
lina: Customer also asked for sub-processor list for the EU region and whether backups are retained outside region.

alex: Quick legal note: for DPA erasure we should state our role (processor) and the customer role (controller). Provide them a short attestation: we process and can remove their data on request; we use managed KMS (Cloud KMS) with HSM protection in eu-west1; backups are stored in-region for the last 30 days unless they opted into cross-region DR (they did not). Keep wording conservative.

marta: Actionable infra steps I will do now:
```
# fetch audit log slice for KMS and storage operations
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_function OR resource.type=cloudkms_keyring" \
  --project=redwood-prod --start-time="2026-11-09T14:15:00Z" --end-time="2026-11-09T14:30:00Z" \
  --filter='protoPayload.methodName:("google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" OR "storage.objects.insert")' \
  --order=timestamp --limit=200 > /tmp/T-48291-audit.json
```
I'll sanitize principal emails and produce a redacted JSON audit slice plus a human-readable timeline.

raj: When you have the audit slice, I will annotate which entries satisfy DPA evidence for key operations and produce the HSM metadata export (signed by security). We'll include: key name, location, protectionLevel, creationTime, and IAM bindings snapshot at time of event.
lina: Great. Any blockers on producing the export proof for the customer within 48h?

marta: No blockers — I need 30–60m to run the query and redact. I may ask infra-sre for a rotated service account check if the PERMISSION_DENIED is unexpected.

raj: Also note: the export failed because our export job attempted to use a service account that had its KMS decrypt role removed earlier in a permissions cleanup. That cleanup is recorded — I'll link the PR. This is relevant for root cause and we should include it in the incident note to the customer.
lina: Can you draft the customer-facing proof summary? Minimal legal-friendly wording plus the attached redacted audit JSON and HSM metadata. I'll send it once we have the files.

alex: Draft suggestion for the attestation body (suggested copy):
"Redwood Inference (processor) confirms receipt of an erasure request and has performed a scoped audit of the processing activities for org_aceu_004. Attached are redacted audit log entries showing the export attempt and KMS operations, and a metadata export for the KMS key used (location: eu-west1, protectionLevel: HSM). Backups for this org are retained in-region for up to 30 days; no cross-region backups were configured. We will complete data removal steps and provide a final deletion confirmation within 7 days"

lina: Perfect. Once marta/raj upload artifacts, I'll attach and update ticket T-48291. Please @mention me when ready. :thumbsup:
marta: Uploading artifacts to the secure share now; will post link here when done (will be internal redacted link).
support-bot: Artifact upload recorded: /secure-share/T-48291/audit_slice_redacted.json (access: security + support + legal).

raj: Linking PR that removed KMS role: https://internal.repo/pulls/4321 — shows service account role change at 2026-11-09T13:58Z. We'll include this as RCA appendix.
lina: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the customer message and ask them if they need a formal signed attestation. If they do, legal will prepare it. Closing loop in ticket after I send the note.

marta: Done — artifacts uploaded and I verified redactions.

raj: Security attestation prepared and signed (internal); ready to attach when Lina confirms.

lina: Sending to customer now and will update thread with their response. If they request a physical HSM certificate or additional audit, escalate to compliance for formal attestation.

support-bot: Ticket T-48291 updated: evidence attached, awaiting customer confirmation.
